title: P53: ParticipantListUpdate apply order and indices
description: protocol-06 §7.5 leaves apply semantics open (wg mimid-1wgh.37.48). Chosen by Mark 2026-10-18: all indices (changedRoleParticipants, removedIndices) refer to the list BEFORE the update; apply role changes, then removals (no shifting until all removals are applied), then append addedParticipants. Any out-of-range or duplicate index, or a resulting duplicate user, rejects the whole update (no partial application). Mirrors .3.19.
notes: 2026-11-04: SUPERSEDED by decision mimid-1wgh.6.75 (protocol-07 §7.5 epoch-start indexing).
